```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(fs)
library(ergm)
library(tictoc)
library(texreg)
```

Github repository with the code used:
<https://github.com/juanrocha/Net-Adopt>

When interpreting results, remember that `b1` are municipalities, and
`b2` companies.

## Dynamic analysis (`tergm`)

```{r}
load("data/termg_260504.Rda")
```

This is the model we discussed and were happy with by mid-May 2026. It
fits the following model formula: 

```{r }
mod$formula
```


```{r warning=FALSE}
mod |> broom::tidy() |> 
    mutate(p_value = case_when(
        p.value < 0.01 ~ "< 0.01",
        p.value >=0.01 & p.value < 0.05 ~ "< 0.05",
        p.value >= 0.05 ~ "> 0.05"
    )) |>
    separate(col = term, into =c("process", "term"), sep = "~") |>
    mutate(term = as_factor(term) |> fct_rev()) |> 
    ggplot(aes(estimate, term)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = p_value, shape = p_value)) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = estimate - std.error, xmax = estimate + std.error,
                       color = p_value), width = 0.5) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
    facet_wrap(~process, )
    #theme(legend.position = c(0.9,0.1), legend.position.inside = TRUE)

```

```{r results='asis'}
htmlreg(mod, bold = 0.05, 
    custom.note = "Coefficients with $p < 0.05$ in **bold**.",)
```


## Static analysis (`ergm` + control year - 1 )

The object `fits` is a list of models for the last three years of the
time series. The formula used in the model is:

```{r, echo=TRUE, eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ergm(
#     x ~ edges + 
#         gwb2degree(fixed = TRUE, decay=2.85) + isolates() + 
#         F(~gwb2degree(fixed = TRUE, decay=2.85), ~nodefactor("cat_commit", levels = "high") ) +
#         F(~gwb2degree(fixed = TRUE, decay=2.85), ~nodefactor("cat_commit", levels = "low")) +
#         gwb2dsp(fixed=TRUE, decay = 0.75) +
#         b2cov("countries") + b2cov("buyers") +
#         b1cov("prop_commit") * b2cov("risk") +
#         b1cov("soy")  + b2cov("prop_commit") * b1cov("risk") + b2cov("soy") + 
#         edgecov(as.sociomatrix(y), attrname = "past_net") 
# )

```

```{r}
load("data/tergms_260813.Rda")
fits <- transpose(fits) # because they were fitted with safely
fits$error |> map(is.null) |> unlist() |> all() # no errors

yrs <- names(fits$result)
fits$result |> 
    map(broom::tidy) |>
    map2(.y = yrs, function(x,y) {
        x <- add_column(x, year = y)
        return(x)
        }) |> 
    bind_rows() |> 
    mutate(
        p_val = case_when(
            p.value < 0.05 ~ "p < 0.05",
            p.value > 0.1 ~ "p > 0.1",
            .default = "0.05 > p < 0.1") |> 
            as_factor() |> 
            fct_relevel("p < 0.05", "0.05 > p < 0.1","p > 0.1"),
        term = as_factor(term) |> fct_rev()) |> 
    ggplot(aes(estimate, term)) + 
    geom_point(aes(color = p_val)) + 
    geom_errorbar(
        aes(xmin = estimate - std.error, xmax = estimate + std.error, color = p_val), orientation = "y", width = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey", linetype =2) +
    facet_wrap(~year) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE,results='asis'}
htmlreg(
    fits$result, bold = 0.05, 
    custom.note = "Coefficients with $p < 0.05$ in **bold**.",
    custom.coef.names = c("edges", "gwb2deg", "isolates", "nodefactor high commit", "nodefactor low commit", "gwb2dsp", "b2 countries", "b2 buyers", "b1 prop commit", "b2 risk", "b1 prop commit:b2 risk", "b1 soy", "b2 prop commit", "b1 risk", "b2 prop commit:b1 risk", "b2 soy", "past net"))
```

Here are the goodness of fit diagnostics, only the ones for the last
model (2020) are plotted, but all others look alike.

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=7}
mcmc.diagnostics(fits$result[[3]])
```

```{r}
tic()
gof3 <- gof(fits$result[[3]])
toc() # 75s
```

```{r dev.args=list(pointsize = 1), fig.height=6}
#op <- par()
par(mfrow = c(3,2))
plot(gof3, cex = 1)
```
